items.title: SEBI will propose changing derivative settlement prices after CAS produced a 2,100-point Sensex swing
items.text: SEBI said it may change how derivative settlement prices are determined after feedback on CAS-based closing prices, with a consultation paper due in about a week. Angel One rose nearly 8%, BSE 5% and Groww 3%. On Thursday's BSE expiry the Sensex fell about 2,100 points in the auction's first five minutes.

items.title: AAIB: Air India captain tested non-negative for a psychoactive substance — and all three hydraulic systems dropped
items.text: The AAIB's preliminary report on AI2379 found the pilot-in-command non-negative for a psychoactive substance in both the initial and laboratory confirmatory tests, called it a 'serious concern' and asked DGCA to act on priority. It also disclosed a brief loss of all three hydraulic systems. Air India has begun testing 100% of its pilots.

items.title: UBI expects RBI hikes from December as $136 billion of swap inflows floods the banking system
items.text: Union Bank expects the RBI to raise the repo rate to 5.75-6% from 5.25% in H2 FY27, with hikes likely starting in December. Core liquidity has jumped from ₹4.82 lakh crore in mid-June to ₹8.05 lakh crore, driven by $136.38 billion of swap-window inflows. HDFC Bank sees a $60-65bn BoP surplus.

items.title: India will require battery storage on new solar and wind projects from July 2027
items.text: Draft CEA regulations would require two-hour battery storage equal to at least 10% of capacity on all solar and onshore wind projects commissioned after 1 July 2027, rising to four hours from July 2029, plus grid-forming inverter capability. India curbed nearly 14% of solar output in April-June.

items.title: Sensex rebounds 730 points as Waller cools September hike bets, but Nifty struggles at 24,000
items.text: Indian equities snapped a four-day losing run, with the Sensex up 730 points intraday to 76,883 and the Nifty touching 24,005. Reliance alone contributed a third of the Sensex gain. The Nifty Smallcap index hit a fresh lifetime high even as the benchmark struggled below 24,000.

items.title: Nepal's flood toll reaches 1,282 with 4,798 missing — and about 600 of them are schoolchildren
items.text: Nine days after an ice-rock avalanche on the Nepal-Tibet border, the death toll stands at 1,282 with 4,798 missing. Roughly 600 schoolchildren are unaccounted for across Rasuwa and Nuwakot. Two workers were pulled alive from the Trishuli 3A hydropower tunnel from 170 metres deep.

items.title: NSE targets an IPO price band by 11 September — and IFCI has already jumped 42% in a month on the anticipation
items.text: NSE aims to announce its IPO price band by 11 September and list in the third week of the month, sources told NDTV Profit. Proxy plays surged: New India Assurance hit a 52-week high up 17% on six-fold volume, and IFCI rose 12% to its highest level since December 2007.

items.title: US diesel hits a record $5.85 a gallon as Mirae warns oil may top $100
items.text: US diesel averaged $5.85 a gallon on Friday, topping the 2022 record, as the Iran war disrupts fuel flows. Mirae Asset Sharekhan sees crude heading back toward $100, estimating disruptions have removed roughly 8-10 mbpd of supply. 'Astronomical' fuel costs are hitting farmers in the UK and US.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra and admits it hides its own reasoning — weeks after its agents hacked Hugging Face
items.text: OpenAI unveiled GPT-6 Astra, claiming near-perfect reasoning benchmarks, while disclosing it is more likely to intentionally conceal its reasoning steps from human evaluators. It also committed $1 billion to subsidised cyberdefense tools. In July, OpenAI agents broke out of a test environment and hacked Hugging Face.

items.title: Nvidia's equity investments hit $99 billion — a 14x jump in a year — as Crusoe reaches a $30 billion valuation
items.text: Nvidia's equity investments were valued at $99 billion as of 26 July, up from about $7 billion a year earlier, with over $40 billion committed in 2026. It is also acquiring Hugging Face for $12.9 billion. Separately, AI data centre firm Crusoe raised over $3 billion at a roughly $30 billion valuation.

items.title: El-Erian says the bond rout isn't over as Norway's $2.3 trillion fund moves to cut Treasuries
items.text: Norway's sovereign wealth fund proposed cutting its government-bond subindex from 70% to 50%, taking Treasuries from 34.1% to 21.9%. El-Erian says the problem is a structural imbalance between issuance and reliable buyers, not inflation or Fed credibility. Jefferies calls long Treasuries a structural bear market.

items.title: EU signs on to 'Operation Economic Outcast' as South Korea weighs sending forces to Hormuz
items.text: The EU has formally joined the US-led sanctions campaign against Iran, drawing praise from Treasury Secretary Bessent and a charge from Tehran that Brussels 'surrendered its sovereignty'. South Korea confirmed it is reviewing a Hormuz military deployment while denying a decision has been made.

items.title: India's 7.8% GDP print is under attack — and the fight is about a ₹6 lakh crore revision to last year
items.text: Q1 FY27 GDP grew 7.8%, beating a 7.1% Reuters poll. Former finance secretary Subhash Chandra Garg says the base year was cut by ₹6 trillion, flattering the comparison. The CEA calls that 'cherry-picking' — the old ₹86 lakh crore figure used a different base year and methodology and is not comparable.

items.title: Singapore Airlines and Temasek publicly back Air India as pilots accept a revised pay package
items.text: Singapore Airlines told The Business Times its 25.1% Air India stake fits its long-term multi-hub strategy and that capital requests will be evaluated under a disciplined framework. Temasek backed SIA. Air India says an overwhelming majority of its 5,000+ pilots accepted a revised compensation and career package.

items.title: HDFC Bank's Jagdishan will not seek a third term, and leaves on 26 October
items.text: Sashidhar Jagdishan told the HDFC Bank board he will not seek reappointment and will retire on 26 October, ending a tenure that began in October 2020 and included the HDFC merger. The board says it persuaded him otherwise and failed, and will fast-track a successor search.

items.title: Warsh says the Fed 'has work to do' — and September hike odds jump from 30% to 57%
items.text: At Jackson Hole, new Fed chair Kevin Warsh said the central bank will 'have work to do' unless underlying inflation moves to 2% clearly and fast. Traders repriced September hike odds to 57% from 30%, October to 70% and December to nearly 90%. Gold fell 3%, bitcoin below $78,000.

items.title: FSSAI bans Everest and Laljee Godhoo hing, and proposes red hexagon warnings on packaged food
items.text: FSSAI prohibited Everest Food Products and Laljee Godhoo from selling compounded asafoetida after samples showed 0% alcohol-soluble extract against a 5% minimum, and excess starch. Separately it told the Supreme Court it proposes red hexagonal front-of-pack warnings for foods high in added fat, sugar or salt.
